title: TURBULENCE THEORY ＆ MODELING
description: Turbulence phenomenology; spatial and temporal scales in turbulent flows; statistical description, filtering and Reynolds decomposition, equations governing the resolved flow, fluctuations and their energetics; turbulence closure problem for RANS and LES; two equation turbulence models and second moment closures
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: ( ENME E3161 ) or ENME E3161 Ordinary and partial differential equations.
